title: Barkpark template manifest
description: Declarative deploy descriptor. A deploy-button UI enumerates templates by reading these files; a server-side bootstrap job consumes one to stand up a Barkpark-backed site (workspace + schema + seed + publish + read-token + env) without an ad-hoc install.sh. See templates/MANIFEST.md.

manifestVersion.description: Descriptor format version. v1 files carry "1".

name.description: Lowercase kebab slug — the identity a deploy UI keys and routes on.

title.description: Human title shown in the deploy UI.

description.description: One-line description of what the template produces.

repo.description: Git URL of the deployable app. Optional — a template living in this monorepo omits it.

dataset.description: Target dataset. Defaults to "production" when omitted.

demoContent.description: True when the template ships illustrative sample content rather than a bare scaffold.

schemas.description: Relative paths (from this manifest) to schema files, applied in order. At least one.

seed.description: Optional seed content and how to apply it.

path.description: Relative path to the seed file.

format.description: How the seed is applied. mutations = {mutations:[…]} POST body (lands DRAFTS; needs a publish pass). ndjson = newline-delimited documents. script = an executable seed script that does its own create+publish.

publish.description: Publish seeded documents after they land. createOrReplace writes DRAFTS, so publish is a separate mutation. Ignored for the "script" format (the script owns publishing).

publishType.description: Document type to publish. REQUIRED when publish is true on the "mutations" format, because the publish mutation needs {id,type}.

env.description: Environment the provisioner must materialize on the deploy target.

role.description: server = server-only (secrets, tokens, API base — never shipped to the browser). public = safe to expose (a NEXT_PUBLIC_ value).

source.description: Where the value comes from during bootstrap. literal = baked into this manifest (see value).

value.description: The baked value — only for source "literal".
